chunks: And in another report, he said:
"Indeed, the hymen may be lost without intercourse; it may go due to injury, stumbling, or falling."

key_terms.بِالنَّكْبَةِ: due to an injury or blow

ai.seo_question: Can the hymen be lost without intercourse according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This report states that the hymen may be lost without sexual intercourse. Its legal significance is to clarify that physical signs alone are not definitive proof of intercourse in cases involving accusation and legal judgment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: In another narration, Imam (as) said: "Indeed, the hymen may be lost without intercourse; it can be lost due to injury, stumbling, or falling."
